title: SDK test orchestration: deterministic fixtures, VCR tests, and contract suite for Python/TS/Go
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Provide deterministic, language-agnostic test tooling for our SDKs so developers can reliably test retries, streaming ergonomics, and example scenarios locally and in CI. Scope: recorder/fixture format, VCR-style replay for unit/integration tests, a lightweight in-process mock server for scripted behaviors (timeouts, partial streaming, 5xxs), and a contract test harness that validates critical Redwood API endpoints against staging. Deliverables: recorder libs (Python/TS/Go), fixture schema, mock-server adapters for pytest/jest/go test harness, CI integration (fast replay for PRs, nightly contract run), docs + examples. Out of scope: full production-grade gateway; long-term chaos-monkey framework (we'll prototype scripted chaos via mock server).

acceptance_criteria: Deterministic fixture framework for Python/TS/Go that records and replays streaming responses including partial chunks and injected errors
VCR-style tests integrated into each SDK test suite and runnable locally and in CI without network calls (replay mode)
Lightweight in-process mock server with programmable behavior for retries/backoff/timeouts and the ability to script partial stream closures
Contract test harness that runs nightly against Redwood staging and fails on schema or semantic regressions (model ids, error codes, major shape changes)
Developer docs and short examples showing record -> edit -> replay workflow for all three SDKs
implementation_notes: Recorder must capture: request metadata (method, path, headers), request body, response streaming frames (sequence id, payload chunk base64, is_final), timing deltas between frames, and response codes
Fixture storage format: newline-delimited JSON (JSONL) with a top-level metadata record and subsequent event records. Keep canonical fixtures language-agnostic.
Redaction: implement configurable redaction rules at record time to strip Authorization, Cookie, and PII-like patterns before persisting fixtures
Mock server modes: replay-from-fixture (deterministic), scripted behaviors (delay, intermittent 5xx, truncated stream), and inspector mode (for manual debugging)
CI strategy: PR-level fast tests use replay-only fixtures; nightly job runs contract tests against staging and emits a compact diff report for failures
Tooling: provide 'rw-vcr' CLI to record, validate, and migrate fixtures between languages (helpful when a Python dev records and TS team replays)
Versioning: tie fixture schema version to SDK runtime. Add schema version header to each fixture to enable migration tooling.
implementation_plan: Week 1: finalize fixture schema and build minimal recorder for Python and TypeScript; record sample chat/generate sessions
Week 2: build in-process mock server adapters for pytest and jest; add Go test harness with replay adapter
Week 3: instrument SDKs to use fixtures for tests covering retries, backoff, streaming chunk reassembly, and resume-on-interruption
Week 4: author initial contract assertions for chat/generate/embeddings and add nightly CI job against staging
Week 5: finalize docs, publish examples, and run cross-team demo to collect feedback
qa_steps: Record a streaming chat session that includes a simulated transient disconnect, then replay locally and assert the token chunk sequence and reconstruction matches the original
Simulate 500/503 responses in mock server and validate SDK retry/backoff behavior and emitted metrics (retry_count, final_status)
Run the contract test harness against staging: ensure schema compatibility for core endpoints and fail on unexpected new top-level fields or removed required fields
Cross-language portability: replay a Python-recorded fixture in the TS and Go harnesses to ensure format portability and consistent semantic outcomes
Run PR CI job in 'replay' mode to ensure PRs remain fast; verify nightly job fails fast with actionable diff artifacts
notes: Keep fixtures compact (JSONL with base64-encoded frame payloads). Aim for a simple default recorder API: record(path, out_file, redact_rules=[]). Encourage recording short synthetic examples in CI to reduce noise. Future: add automatic fixture shrinker that removes non-deterministic timing deltas while preserving necessary frame ordering.
risk_assessment: Medium: incorrect redaction could leak secrets if recorder runs against production traffic
Low: replay overhead for unit tests is small, but poorly authored fixtures can increase CI run time
High: staging instability will cause flaky contract tests; mitigate with feature flags and selective semantic assertions
